name: kuttl-v0.28.0
body:
## 🚀 Highlights

- feat: add TestCase/TestRunSelector to skip a test case (#730)
- feat: dump remaining namespace contents when deletion times out (#737)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- fix: run collectors on early step errors too (#735)
- fix: handle variable fractional seconds in junit golden normalization (#736)

## 🔧  Other Changes

- chore: replace `interface{}` -> `any` (#726)
- ci: migrate release-drafter category labels to 'when' condition (#727)

## 🌱 Dependency bumps

- chore(deps): bump github.com/moby/moby/client from 0.6.0 to 0.6.2 (#732, #734)
- chore(deps): bump github.com/moby/moby/api from 1.56.0 to 1.56.1 (#733)
- chore(deps): bump sigs.k8s.io/controller-tools from 0.22.0 to 0.23.0 in the kubernetes group (#738)
- chore(deps): bump sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime from 0.25.1 to 0.25.2 in the kubernetes group (#731)
- chore(deps): bump the kubernetes group with 5 updates (#729)

## Contributors

@chenwng, @georgRusanov, @porridge, @pujitha24 and [@dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot)
